text: I have been feeling very tired lately and I drink water constantly. I also pee very frequently especially at night.
My vision has become blurry and I feel exhausted all the time. I have also been losing weight without trying.
I feel hungry all the time even after eating. My mouth is always dry and I go to the bathroom very often.
I noticed a new mole on my arm that was not there before. It keeps getting bigger and has different colors in it.
There is a spot on my skin that bleeds sometimes when I touch it and it has not healed in weeks.
I have a rough scaly patch on my face that itches constantly and the skin looks crusty and red.
I always feel drained and have no energy. My sugar levels are not stable and my wounds heal very slowly.
My skin has an uneven mole that changed shape recently. It also has a dark and light area mixed together.
I feel restless and have no motivation. I am always thirsty and I urinate many times during the day.
There is a shiny pearl-like bump on my shoulder that was not there before and it feels sensitive when touched.
I have been gaining weight and feel very sluggish. My eyesight is getting worse and I get tired after small effort.
A red patch appeared on my neck that does not fade. It looks irritated all the time and sometimes it scabs over.
I wake up many times at night to urinate and I feel constantly hungry even though I eat a lot.
I have a sore on my leg that keeps opening up. It heals for a day and then opens again. It has been there for months.
